content: Kerutsaremetsie kememɨte'uyu'eni
Hikɨ hipatɨ Kureya meheyekɨneka mekateniwa'ɨkitɨakaitɨni ta'iwama mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «Xeme xɨka xitekiyakɨ xeka'u'inɨaritɨarieni kemaine Muitsexi yeiyarieya, xepɨkayɨwawe xemɨtawikweitsitɨarienikɨ».

Papuru meta Werunawe yemekɨ mekaniniukixiekaitɨni mɨiremekɨ wahepaɨtsita. 'Aixɨa mekaniyurieni Papuru Werunawe hamatɨa meta hipatɨ yuri memɨte'erie mɨkɨ yunaitɨ Kerutsareme mekanekɨne, nɨ'ariekate meta 'ukirawetsixi wahetsɨa 'ikɨ niuki hepaɨtsita memɨtehetixatakɨ.

Mana memɨyutixexeɨriwakai mepɨwarenɨ'a. Penitsiyatsie meta Tsamariyatsie mepuyekɨ metekuxatatɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi wahepaɨtsita kename yuri mete'uta'eriwakai. Mɨkɨ niuki me'enietɨ yuri memɨte'erie 'iwamarixi waɨkawamekɨ mekaniyutemamawiekaitɨni.
Kerutsareme me'uta'axɨaku, mana memɨyutixexeɨriwakai, nɨ'ariekate meta 'ukirawetsixi yunaitɨ mekaniwarutanaki'erieni. Memɨtewarutaxatɨakɨ naime Kakaɨyari kemɨtiyurienekai wahamatɨa 'uyeikatɨ.

Hikɨ hipatɨ paritseutsixi wahepaɨ memɨteku'eriwakai mekananuku'uni mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: —Peuyewetse memɨkahuriyutsixi temɨwata'aitɨanikɨ memɨ'inɨaritɨarienikɨ xitekiyakɨ, 'inɨari niukiyari Muitsexi 'aitsikayatsie yamemɨtekahunikɨ.
Hikɨ nɨ'ariekate meta 'ukirawetsixi mekaniyukuxeɨrieni 'aixɨa meteyurienike 'ikɨ niuki hepaɨtsita.

Waɨkawa niuki mexɨatɨakaku, Pekuru 'anukukeka mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Neuxei 'iwamarixi, xeme mɨpaɨ xepɨtemate, Kakaɨyari meripaitɨ pɨnetsi'anayexei xetsata, mɨkɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne memi'enienikɨ ne ne'utaniukakaku, mɨkɨkɨ memɨtawikweitsitɨarienikɨ.
Kakaɨyari ta'iyari mɨmatekɨ katiniwarutahekɨatɨani wapitɨatɨ 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata tame tahepaɨ.
Yɨkɨ katatixeiyatɨ mɨkɨ meta tame. Yuri mete'uta'erieku wa'iyaritsie kaniwaru'itieni.
Hikɨ kamɨtsɨ, ¿ketitayari Kakaɨyari xete'inɨatatɨwe, yuyeiyari xetewaranuyetekirie teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete turutsixi kwietsanamete wahepaɨ? Tatutsima meta tameta tepɨtatexiekai yuku temanuyetenikɨ.
Matsi Ti'aitame Ketsutsi 'aixɨa tiuka'iyarikaku tame yuri tepɨte'erie temɨtawikweitsitɨarienikɨ.

Hikɨ yunaitɨ muwa memuyuxeɨriekai kayuwatɨ meputamarixɨ, memɨwa'enienikɨ Werunawe meta Papuru metehekɨatame 'inɨari mamariwaweme Kakaɨyari kemɨtiyurienekai memɨkahuriyutsixi watsata mɨkɨ metekuxatakaku.
Mete'utahayewaka metekuxatatɨ, Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Ne'iwamarixi xekeneneu'eni.
Tsimuni katiniutahekɨata Kakaɨyari meripaitɨ kemɨtiyuwaɨri menuyexeiyakɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi watsata hetsɨana memɨmiemetetɨnikɨ.
Yaxeikɨa paine Kakaɨyari niukametemama waniuki, mɨpaɨ kemɨre'utɨarie hepaɨ:
»'Ayumieme ne mɨpaɨ nepɨtiku'eriwa, tepɨkawa'uximatɨaka mɨkɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi Kakaɨyaritsie yuri memɨte'uta'erikɨ.

Matsi 'aixɨa pɨyɨni temɨtewata'utɨirienikɨ memɨyukweriwayuriekakɨ, tita kakaɨyarixi memɨtemawiyarie mɨkɨ hepaɨtsita, memɨkawakumaɨwanikɨ mɨkayɨ'ɨya mɨkayɨkɨna, 'ukawiyayu waiyarieya hepaɨtsita memɨyukweriwayuriekakɨ meta xuriya memɨkakwa'anikɨ.
'Iya Muitsexi meripaitɨ hikɨke pɨwarexeiya mɨkɨ memitahekɨata kiekari mukumanetsie watukiteta yamemɨte'ititerɨwa 'uxipiya tukaritsie.
Memɨyutixexeɨriwa metehaka'utɨaka mekaneinɨ'ani

Hikɨ nɨ'ariekate meta 'ukirawetsixi wahamatɨa yunaitɨ memɨyutixexeɨriwakai wahamatɨa 'aixɨa 'anekame mekani'eriekaitɨni yutsata memɨwaranuyexeiyakɨ hipame, memɨwaranunɨ'anikɨ 'Anutiyukiya paitɨ Papuru meta Werunawe wahamatɨa. Mekaniwaranuyexeiya Kura Warɨtsawaxi mɨtitewakai, meta Tsiraxi. Mɨkɨ mepɨte'aitametetɨkai yu'iwama watsata.

Mɨpaɨ mete'u'utɨaka xapatsie mekaneinɨ'ani: Nɨ'ariekate meta 'ukirawetsixi 'iwamarixi, Tekanixewaɨritɨaka, meta ta'iwamarixi xemɨkahuriyutsixi 'Anutiyukiyatsie, Tsiriyatsie meta Tsiritsiyatsie xemɨtama.

Tepu'enana kename hipatɨ tahetsɨa miemete mexexamurietɨwekai yuniukikɨ xe'iyari meyuitɨatɨwetɨ mexe'aitɨatɨ xemɨyu'inɨaritɨanikɨ xitekiyakɨ, 'inɨari niukiyaritsie yaxemɨtekahunikɨ. Tame tepɨkatewa'aitɨa.
Hikɨ, 'axeikɨa te'uta'enieka temɨwaranayexeiyakɨ hipame 'iwamarixi xehetsɨa temɨwaranunɨ'anikɨ Werunawe meta Papuru temɨwanaki'erie wahamatɨa.
Mɨkɨ yutukari mekaniyetuakaitɨni Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu Tati'aitɨwame hetsɨa memɨmiemetekɨ.
'Ayumieme, tepɨwarenɨ'a Kura meta Tsiraxi. Mɨkɨta yuniukikɨ yaxeikɨa mepɨtexehekɨatɨani.
'Aixɨa pɨtiyurie, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata, meta tame waɨriyarika temɨkaxepitɨakakɨ, 'ikɨ hepaɨtsita kemɨreuyewetse:

xemɨka'ikwakakɨ tita kakaɨyarixi memɨtemawiyarie, xuriya, mukawiya waiyarieya, kemɨ'ane mɨkaxe'ɨya mɨkaxekɨna xemɨkawakumaɨwanikɨ. Xeme xɨka mɨkɨ xeka'umayɨani, 'aixɨa xepɨyɨaka. Mɨpaɨ xeikɨa kani'aneni.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ memeyenɨ'arie 'Anutiyukiyatsie mekaniu'axɨani. Yunaime mewarukuxeɨrieka xapa mekaniyetuani.
'Iwamarixi me'itaterɨwaka mekaniyutemamawiekaitɨni memɨtuikariekaikɨ.
Kura meta Tsiraxi Kakaɨyari niukametemama mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, waɨkawa metekuxatatɨ mekaniwatuikakaitɨni yu'iwama, mekaniwatseiriyakaitɨni.
Yapaɨmexɨa tukari me'uyurieka, yu'iwama wahetsɨa mekanekɨne 'aixɨa metewaxeiyatɨ. Mɨkɨ memɨwareyenɨ'a wahetsɨa mekaniu'axɨani.
Papuru meta Werunawe 'Anutiyukiyatsie mekaniuyuhayewa mete'ɨkitatɨ, Ti'aitame niukieya 'aixɨa manuyɨne mekuxatatɨ meta hipame yumɨireme wahamatɨa.
Papuru meta Werunawe kememɨkateyu'eniexɨa

Hikɨ yapaɨmexɨa tukari 'anukayaku, Papuru Werunawe mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Kɨmɨtsɨari hutarieka tepɨyehu, ta'iwamarixi tepɨwa'iwatayu naime kiekaritetsie hakewa Ti'aitame niukieya temetaxatsie, kemetehe'uwa tepɨwaxeiyayu».
Werunawe Wani Marikuxi mɨtitewakai kani'iniekaitɨni.
Papuru hepaɨtsita 'aixɨa pɨka'anekai memenuwitɨnikɨ mɨwareku'eiriekaikɨ Pamɨpiriyatsie, wahamatɨa mɨkahetɨakɨ mɨti'uximayakakɨ.
'Ayumieme mepɨka'uyu'eniexɨa, mepautayeixɨa yuxexuitɨ. Werunawe Marikuxi hawitɨtɨ kanuwa 'amɨpatsie Tsipɨre paitɨ mekanekɨne.
Matsi Papuru Tsiraxi 'anayexeiyaka kaneyani. Ta'iwamaxi Ti'aitame mekaniuhɨritɨani 'aixɨa mɨtiuka'iyarinikɨ mɨkɨ hetsiemieme.
Tsiriyatsie meta Tsiritsiyatsie puyetɨa watuikatɨ mana memɨyutixexeɨriwakai.
